headline: The digital revolution is entering businesses, but nearly one in two is left out of
summary: A survey of 177 companies in Umbria found 32 already use artificial intelligence and 61 intend to invest in it over three years. The remaining 84 neither use it nor plan to adopt it in the short to medium term.
why: Business adoption of artificial intelligence affects productivity and competitiveness, shaping which firms and regional economies gain or lose from the technology.
